vocab.en: you or I, an older man
you or I, an older woman
you or I, a younger person

segments.script: [EN: Warm up from yesterday.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say hello.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: Say thank you.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn.] [EN: The polite yes.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Dạ, cảm ơn.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Yes, thank you.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: In Vietnamese you address people by age and gender. There is no neutral you. Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To an older man, use] [VI_F: Anh.] [EN: This means you, or I, for an older man. It has a flat tone.] [EN: Say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To an older woman, use] [VI_F: Chị.] [EN: This means you, or I, for an older woman. It has a falling, broken tone.] [EN: Say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To a younger person, use] [VI_F: Em.] [EN: This means you, or I, for a younger person. It has a flat tone.] [EN: Say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Em.] [EN: Now greet an older man, attach his pronoun.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào anh.] [EN: Greet an older woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào chị.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Address an older man.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh.] [EN: Address an older woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị.] [EN: Address a younger person.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Em.] [EN: Thank an older woman, attach her pronoun.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn chị.] [EN: Thank an older man.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn anh.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Chị.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: You or I, an older woman.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Em.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: You or I, a younger person.] [EN: And the polite yes from before.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen. A younger clerk greets an older customer.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, xin chào anh.] [VI_M: Chào em.] [VI_F: Dạ, cảm ơn anh nha.] [VI_M: Cảm ơn em.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Greet an older woman politely.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, xin chào chị.] [EN: Thank an older man.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cảm ơn anh.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you ask prices and start counting. The preview phrase is] [VI: bao nhiêu] [EN: which means how much.]
